title: Bluetooth
description: Read BLE sensors near the Docker host.
scope: Discovery and readings run through the server using BlueZ or a native host relay. No browser Bluetooth permission is required. Standard temperature, air humidity and battery are supported.
globalOnly: An integration manager with access to all locations is required.
setup: Enable Bluetooth and configure Linux BlueZ access or the native host relay.
noCandidates: No compatible sensors found. Move the sensor closer to the server and try again.
paired: Sensor added and first readings saved.
pending: Server operation in progress. You may leave this page; processing continues on the server.

errors.unsupportedDevice: No supported readable GATT channels found.
errors.invalidReading: The sensor returned an invalid measurement.
errors.timeout: The server Bluetooth operation timed out. Check the sensor and queue worker.
errors.disconnected: The sensor is unreachable from the server.
errors.failed: The Bluetooth request failed. Try again.
errors.unavailable: Bluetooth is unavailable. Check the host driver, native relay or BlueZ access, and queue worker.
errors.busy: Another Bluetooth operation is running. Try again shortly.
errors.expired: Discovery expired. Scan again before adding the sensor.
errors.accessLost: Your integration access changed. Sign in again.
errors.disabled: The device or channel is disabled, or its configuration changed.
errors.typeConflict: The channel measurement type changed. Check its configuration.
errors.invalidTime: The sample timestamp is too old or in the future.
errors.sampleConflict: A different measurement already exists at this time.
errors.conflict: The configuration changed. Refresh before trying again.
errors.relayConfiguration: Check the relay URL, private host address, TLS and access token.
